name: agent_runtime_helpers_repair_tool_call
notes: Traced copy of the REAL port src/tools/registry.c::repair_tool_call (helpers copied verbatim; the file itself drags pthread + tool-result/idempotency deps into the link, so extra_src linking is unclean). The registry contents are mirrored as a fixed 5-name table shared by both sides (twin backs the LIVE fn with a fake agent exposing the same valid_tool_names). Ladder rungs B1-B5 are computed with each side's own real helpers; the value comes from each side's real pipeline including the fuzzy rung (C: levenshtein ratio > 0.7; LIVE: difflib get_close_matches cutoff 0.7). DOCUMENTED DIVERGENCES (excluded inputs): LIVE-only XML-fragment trim (quotes/angle brackets) absent from the port; LIVE camel_snake inserts '_' before EVERY uppercase via regex where the port splits only lower->upper transitions, so ALL-CAPS ('TERMINAL') and upper-after-separator ('Web_Search') inputs diverge at rung B4/B5 and are excluded; the two fuzzy algorithms rank differently for near-cutoff junk strings, so junk inputs are kept long enough that both stay under 0.7. LIVE's set iteration order is nondeterministic but the repaired value is order-independent.
